description: Migration creates unifi_credentials (tenant, credential_id, integration_id, label, mode, local_host_id, status, last_error, last_checked_at, timestamps) with tenant distribution and per-integration unique label
Migration creates unifi_console_routes (tenant, integration_id, host_id, credential_id, console_name, state, last_error, first_seen_at, last_verified_at) keyed by console
Backfill creates one 'Default' credential per existing UniFi integration from legacy secrets, copying mode and local base URL; legacy secrets stay readable until verified
Secrets become per-credential: unifi_api_key:<credential_id> and unifi_local_base_url:<credential_id>, with legacy-name fallback only when no credential rows exist
UniFiApiClient stays the single-key client; UniFiFleetClient composes N of them and exposes testConnection, listConsoles, listSites, listSitesForHost, listDevices, getDevice
createUniFiClient returns a fleet client; a tenant with one credential behaves exactly as today and existing call sites are unchanged
Console discovery unions /v1/hosts across active Site Manager credentials and de-duplicates by hostId
Ownership resolution probes credentials in stable order (local match, then site_manager by created_at) and persists the first successful owner; console_forbidden falls through
Persisted routes are re-probed only on console_forbidden/401, credential disable/remove/replace, full sync, or manual re-check; routine syncs do not re-probe
Local credentials each own one controller; migrated credential keeps host id 'local', new ones get a colon-free generated host id so parseUniFiScopeKey stays valid
A console no credential can reach becomes state=unreachable with one actionable 'add a key created under that fabric' warning, surfaced in settings and the sync result
A 401 marks only that credential reconnect_required; its consoles become uncertain failed scopes (no tombstoning, alerts uncertain); integration is reconnect-required only when every credential is
Retry and rate-limit state is per child client so one throttled key does not slow the others
Security: a stored key is only sent to the destination it was saved with; changing mode or local base URL requires re-entering the key, validated before any write
Settings screen lists credentials (label, mode, status, consoles reached, last error) with add, replace key, relabel and remove, using standard components and never showing ids
Site mapping table shows which credential label reaches each site ('Reached by')
Removing a credential re-routes its consoles among remaining credentials, marks the rest unreachable fail-closed, and asks before unmapping affected sites
Sync result reports per-credential status and unreachableConsoles with suggested action; last_error on the row is the UI's source of truth
UniFi simulator models fabric-scoped keys: key A lists all hosts but 403s connector on fabric consoles, key B lists only its fabric
Setup docs and customer-facing release note explain one Independent key plus one key per fabric and thank Ryan at Tom's Help Desk
